title: Recovery Management Checkup Scalability and Sustainability Hybrid Experiment
official: Recovery Management Checkup Scalability and Sustainability (RMC-SS) Hybrid Experiment: Evaluating Comparability of Client and Implementation Outcomes in Community Organizations Post-Arrest
summary: Individuals who are involved in the criminal-legal system (CLS) are at high risk of drug-related overdose; they also face significant barriers to engaging in substance use disorder (SUD) treatment and recovery support services. To address this public health challenge, this study will test the implementation and outcomes of an evidence-based intervention, Recovery Management Check-ups (RMC), delivered within community-based programs in four Chicago communities that have high rates of drug-related overdose and arrests. The study has the potential to increase uptake of RMC in community-based programs, thereby reducing overdose-related deaths and crime-related costs and improving individual health and community public health.

interventions.name: Recovery Management Checkups (RMC) delivered by community-based agencies (RMC adopters)
Recovery Management Checkups (RMC) delivered by staff under the research team (RMC by research staff)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria (CLIENTS):

* have been arrested in Chicago within the past 90 days,
* primarily reside in a zip code or community within one of the 4 target areas,
* report using weekly (13+ days) of heroin/opioids, cocaine/stimulants, and/or alcohol, and
* be capable of providing informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria (CLIENTS):

* expects to move from Chicago or report to prison within 12 months of enrollment,
* cannot participate in English or Spanish, or
* is already participating in another experiment.

Inclusion Criteria (RMC ADOPTER AGENCIES):

* be a non-profit organization that provide client-centered recovery support services in 1 to 4 of the study high need target areas in Chicago,
* has a history of collaborating other local Opioid Treatment Providers (OTP) and other licensed Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment providers,
* has a history of serving clients who have been recently arrested clients,
* be willing to work with many who may be uninterested in treatment or repeatedly cycling in and out of it, and
* interested in collaborating in the local Hub and national JCOIN cooperative.

Exclusion Criteria (RMC ADOPTER AGENCIES):

* does not meet one or more of the inclusion criteria listed above.
